html:div.html:p: Select an element or route in the diagram to edit it.
Export downloads the current diagram as a JSON file.

html:section.html:p: Hover a route to reveal its label. Click routes to toggle persistent highlights; press Escape to clear them all. Empty canvas clicks do not change the selected routes.
